title: A Composite Bayesian Risk--Distributionally Robust Optimization Model for Stochastic Programming with Elliptical Distribution Ambiguity
summary: We study a stochastic optimization problem in which the random vector follows a semiparametric elliptical distribution with unknown location and shape parameters and an unspecified radial distribution. Assuming that the decision maker only has access to samples of the random vector, we develop a framework to jointly address parameter uncertainty and distributional ambiguity arising from this composite structure.
